banishment_dimension.usage.banishtime: §7/banishtime <add|set> <player> <minutes> (timed banishment: counts online time only, auto-releases on expiry)
banishment_dimension.msg.list.note: §8Records live in the %1$s folder of the server world (plain-text JSON, zero NBT) and survive restarts.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.offline_no_: §cPlayer %1$s is offline and has no record in the banishment folder.
banishment_dimension.msg.ok.released: §aThe banishment of §e%1$s §ais lifted: inventory and game mode restored, record file deleted.
banishment_dimension.msg.ok.pending_mark: §aPending release marked for offline player §e%1$s §a(saved in its record file); they will return to their original spot with the inventory restored at next login.
banishment_dimension.msg.info.pending_al: §e%1$s §7is already queued for release and will be restored on next login.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.not_online: §cPlayer %1$s is offline and cannot be teleported.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.overworld_u: §cThe Overworld is temporarily unavailable; please try again.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.return_bani: §c%1$s is currently banished; /return can only be used on players who are NOT banished. Use /unbanish %1$s to release them.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.banished: §c%1$s has banished you to the Banishment dimension. Here you are cut off from the world until an admin releases you.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.released: §a%1$s has lifted your banishment. You are back in your original world; inventory and game mode have been restored.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.not_your: §eThis is not a place you may stay. Escorting you out.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.expired: §eYour banishment has expired; you have been sent back to the Overworld.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.banishti: §eAn admin added %1$s minute(s) to your banishment; about %2$s minute(s) left.
§eAn admin set your banishment to %1$s minute(s); about %2$s minute(s) left.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.returned: §a%1$s has returned you to the Overworld.
§aYou have been returned to the position you were at before entering the Banishment dimension.
banishment_dimension.msg.notice.escape_h: §eYou are not a banished player, yet you entered the Banishment dimension. Use /escape to return to where you were before, or you will be sent back shortly.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.already_in_: §cYou are already in the banishment dimension.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.dim_not_loa: §cThe banishment dimension failed to load, so the banishment was aborted. Please contact an admin.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.escape_not_: §cThis command can only be used by a player in-game.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.escape_bani: §cYou are a banished player, so /escape does not apply to you; wait for an admin to release you with /unbanish.
banishment_dimension.msg.err.escape_not_: §cYou are not in the Banishment dimension (%1$s), so /escape has no effect.
banishment_dimension.msg.warn.pullback: §cThe banishment system detected you leaving the banishment dimension. You have been forcibly pulled back!
banishment_dimension.msg.warn.dim_unavai: §eThe banishment dimension is temporarily unavailable; your banishment has been released automatically.
banishment_dimension.msg.warn.fallback_d: §eYour banishment is lifted, but the origin dimension is unavailable; your inventory has been dropped at your feet.
banishment_dimension.log.language: Active message language: %1$s (change the language category in banishment.json: zh / en / both)
banishment_dimension.log.variant: Active banishment dimension variant: %1$s (choices: classic / dark / void)
banishment_dimension.log.server_stopping: Server stopping: %1$s banishment record(s) saved to the world folder %2$s; banishment continues after restart.
banishment_dimension.log.server_started: Loaded %2$s banishment record(s) (plain-text JSON, zero NBT) from the server folder %1$s; banishment continues after restart.
banishment_dimension.log.banishtime_expi: Timed banishment expired: %1$s was released automatically and returned to their origin.
